patients.summary: Executive assistant who joined in 2021 with no active problems and a family history of otosclerosis (father) and myotonic dystrophy (mother). Otosclerosis diagnosed by ENT in 2024 and myotonic dystrophy type 1 by neurology in 2025; outside records arrive with gaps and delays.

documents.title: New patient intake call
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Caller Andrea Morrow, 29, would like to move her primary care to us. Previous office was a large group practice and she says she rarely saw the same clinician twice. No urgent concerns. Insurance is an employer PPO through her job, card info taken. Booked new patient physical 9/14 at 8:40, asked her to sign the release so we can get her old records. Membership agreement emailed.

conditions.label: Family history of deafness and hearing loss
conditions.note: father with otosclerosis, hearing aids since his 40s

documents.title: New Patient Preventive Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
29 year old woman establishing care. Feels well. No complaints today.

PMH: none. PSH: wisdom teeth removed. Meds: none, no supplements. Allergies: NKDA.

Family: father has otosclerosis and has worn hearing aids on both sides since his 40s. Mother had myotonic dystrophy, also had cataracts and type 2 diabetes; she died at 50. Maternal grandmother had weakness that came on later in life, family assumed the same muscle disease.

Social: executive assistant at a firm in town, desk job. Single, lives in Amherst. Never smoked. Alcohol a drink or two a month. Exercises by walking.

Gyn: periods regular. Last Pap 2019 at prior office, she believes normal. Had HPV shots as a teenager.

ROS negative across systems, specifically no hearing complaints, no weakness, no trouble swallowing.

Exam: well appearing, pleasant. HEENT: TMs clear, canals normal, oropharynx normal. Neck supple, no thyroid enlargement. Heart regular, no murmur. Lungs clear. Abdomen soft, nontender. Skin unremarkable. Neuro grossly nonfocal, strength full and symmetric.

PHQ-2 0.

A/P
1. Health maintenance: CBC, CMP, lipids. One-time HIV and hepatitis C screens, she agrees. Pap due 2022. Release signed for old records, will confirm Tdap and COVID dates from those. Flu shot once this season's supply comes in, nurse visit.
2. Family history of hearing loss in father, noted. No hearing concerns now.

RTC one year for physical.

documents.title: Your lab results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Andrea, all of your blood work from Tuesday came back normal: blood counts, kidney and liver tests, cholesterol, and the HIV and hepatitis C screens were negative. Nothing to do. Good to meet you.

documents.title: Records from prior primary care office
documents.author: front desk
documents.body:
42 pages received by fax from the patient's previous primary care group, covering 2014 to 2021. Summary for chart:
- Cervical cytology 6/2019: negative for intraepithelial lesion or malignancy.
- Tdap 5/2016.
- COVID-19 Pfizer doses 4/9/2021 and 4/30/2021, given at a pharmacy, entered from her card.
- HPV vaccine series completed in adolescence (dates not listed).
- No chronic problems or medications on their list. NKDA.
Immunizations entered. Abstracted for PCP review.

documents.title: Immunization
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Here on lunch hour for flu vaccine. No fever, no prior reaction. Quadrivalent flu given IM left deltoid, lot recorded. Tolerated, left after a few minutes.

documents.title: Wellness form for work
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Hello, my employer's insurance wants a form signed showing I had a physical in the last 12 months so I get the premium discount. I uploaded it. Is that something you can fill out? Thanks, Andrea

documents.title: RE: Wellness form for work
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Hi Andrea, the form is signed and uploaded back to your portal under Documents. You can download it from there.

reports.text: Specimen: liquid-based cervical cytology with high-risk HPV testing. Specimen adequacy: satisfactory for evaluation, transformation zone component present. Interpretation: negative for intraepithelial lesion or malignancy. High-risk HPV: not detected.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Annual. Doing well, busy year at work. No new symptoms. No hearing trouble, no weakness. Periods regular.

Meds none. NKDA. Never smoker, rare alcohol.
Family history unchanged (father otosclerosis; mother myotonic dystrophy, deceased).

Exam: NAD. Ears: canals and TMs normal. Thyroid normal. Heart RRR no murmur, lungs clear. Abdomen soft. Pelvic: external genitalia normal, cervix without lesions, Pap with HPV collected. Strength 5/5 throughout.

PHQ-2 0.

Plan:
- Pap with HPV today; if both negative next one in 5 years.
- CBC today. Lipids were fine last year, not repeating.
- Flu and bivalent COVID booster given.
- Physical next year.

documents.title: Pap result
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Andrea, your Pap smear was normal and the HPV test was negative, so the next one isn't due until 2027. Blood count from last week was normal too.

documents.title: Appointment cancelled
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Pt called, her boss scheduled an all-day offsite tomorrow and she can't get out of it. Cancelled 10/10 physical, rebooked 11/7 8:20.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Rescheduled from October. Feels well, sleeping fine. PHQ-2 1. Denies hearing or swallowing problems, no weakness.

No meds. NKDA. Nonsmoker. Alcohol unchanged, a drink or two a month.

Exam: well. TMs normal. Neck without adenopathy. Heart and lungs normal. Abdomen benign. Normal gait, normal strength.

A/P: healthy 31 year old.
- CMP today.
- Pap up to date through 2027.
- Flu and 2023-24 COVID vaccine today.
- RTC 1 yr.

documents.title: Labs from your physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Andrea, the metabolic panel from Tuesday was normal, kidney and liver numbers included. Talk next fall.
